subject: hdfs_body
decision_rule: Per subject: GO when unseen/equals/false_positive_share and unseen/like/false_positive_share are both at most 0.10, summary_bytes_share is at most 0.01, and build_cpu_over_zstd is at most 2; otherwise NO-GO, and a missing figure fails its leg. Saturation is a separate verdict: with values over 1024 bytes, saturation/unseen/like/false_positive_share at most 0.30 is body-eligible and above it body-ineligible; with none, untested. Overall: GO when every pre-registered subject has exactly one report, it is GO, and it has no structural problem (a missing, duplicate or unexpected figure); a figure outside its prediction band is reported as a miss and does not change the decision.
summary_bytes_rule: summary_bytes = blocks * ceil(bits_per_block / 8) + learned_bits * gram_len (the shared table of learned grams, each stored as its raw bytes)
